questions.question: King Jehoram of Judah married a daughter of Ahab. Whose ways did he follow?

answers.text: The ways of the kings of Israel
The ways of his father Jehoshaphat
The ways of the prophet Elisha

questions.question: Why did the LORD refuse to destroy Judah in the days of evil King Jehoram?

answers.text: He promised to keep a lamp for David forever
David had asked Him to spare Judah
Judah's people cried out for His mercy
